topic_ko: 1970년대 브롱크스의 절망 속에서 갱단의 평화 협정으로 힙합 문화가 태어남

passage: Picture a city district sliding into ruin after the economy collapses.
Shops shut down, landlords walk away, and empty buildings line every block.
Winter arrives with no heat, and the only residents left are those too poor to leave.
Jobs disappear, gangs multiply, and fighting among the young becomes ordinary.
Then a gang known for feeding and treating its neighbors decides that violence must end.
Its members urge other young people to unite and rebuild the community instead.
Gang leaders across the district agree to a peace treaty and abandon their weapons.
Out of that fragile peace in the Bronx of the early 1970s, hip-hop was born.
choices: the birth of hip-hop out of a community's choice to end violence
the economic policies that caused American cities to decline
the difficulty of enforcing peace treaties between rival groups
the role of free meal programs in reducing urban poverty
the musical techniques that made early hip-hop distinctive
theme.explanation_ko: 폐허가 된 브롱크스에서 갱단이 폭력을 멈추고 평화 협정을 맺었고, 그 평화 위에서 힙합이 탄생했다는 흐름이므로 ①이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ② 경기 침체는 배경일 뿐 글의 초점이 아니다. ③ 협정 이행의 어려움은 언급되지 않았다. ④ 무료 급식은 갱단이 존경받은 이유로 스치듯 나온 세부이다. ⑤ 음악 기법은 이 단락에 없다.

passage: Imagine a neighborhood that falls apart after a severe recession.
Businesses close, owners flee, and abandoned buildings stand without heat through the winter.
Only families who cannot afford to move stay behind.
Unemployment climbs, gangs spread, and violence becomes part of daily life.
One respected gang, known for its free meals and medical care, chooses to stop fighting.
It persuades other young people to unite and build something better together.
Leaders from across the area sign a treaty and vow never to settle disputes by force again.
That decision turned the Bronx into the birthplace of a new culture of peace.
choices: 공동체가 폭력을 끝내기로 한 선택이 새로운 문화를 탄생시켰다.
경제 침체를 막으려면 정부의 신속한 개입이 필요하다.
갱단의 폭력은 결국 더 큰 폭력으로만 해결될 수 있다.
도시의 빈곤은 주민들의 이주를 통해서만 완화된다.
음악은 청소년의 일탈을 예방하는 가장 효과적인 수단이다.
gist.explanation_ko: 폭력을 멈추자는 결단이 평화 협정으로 이어지고 그것이 새 문화의 토대가 되었다는 것이 요지이므로 ①이 적절하다.
gist.distractor_ko: ② 정부 개입은 언급이 없다. ③ 글의 주장과 정반대이다. ④ 이주는 떠나지 못한 사람들의 배경 설명일 뿐이다. ⑤ 예방 수단으로서의 음악은 이 단락의 논점이 아니다.

passage: In the early 1970s the South Bronx was collapsing under an economic downturn.
Storefronts were boarded, owners had vanished, and whole rows of buildings stood empty.
There was no heating in winter, and only the poorest families remained.
Gang violence among young people had become an everyday event.
A gang called the Ghetto Brothers, respected for its free meal and medical programs, decided to stop fighting.
Its members argued that unity, not violence, could make the town worth living in.
Gang leaders from across the area signed a peace treaty and renounced violence.
In that space of peace, hip-hop emerged as the voice of a new culture.
choices: From Broken Streets to a Culture of Peace
The Rules That Every Street Gang Follows
Winter in the Bronx: A Housing Crisis
title.explanation_ko: 무너진 거리에서 평화의 문화가 생겨나는 과정을 담아야 하므로 ①이 제목으로 가장 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ② 경기 침체는 배경이다. ③ 갱단의 규칙은 다루지 않는다. ④ 난방 문제는 세부 묘사이다. ⑤ 협정의 실패는 본문과 반대이다.

passage: After the recession the district emptied out, leaving boarded shops and cold apartments.
Unemployment rose and gang violence became an everyday thing for young people.
Despair is on every street corner.
Then the Ghetto Brothers, respected for feeding and treating their neighbors, called for an end to the fighting.
They asked young people to unite and create a better community.
Leaders from all over the area signed the peace treaty they proposed.
Never again would they use violence to solve their disputes.
The Bronx of the early 1970s became the birthplace of hip-hop.
implication.underlined: Despair is on every street corner.
choices: Hopelessness had spread through every part of the neighborhood.
People gathered on corners to complain about the government.
Street corners were the only safe places left in the district.
Residents deliberately hid their sadness from outsiders.
Each corner of the city was patrolled by a different gang.
implication.explanation_ko: '절망이 거리 구석구석에 있다'는 것은 절망이 동네 전역에 퍼져 있었다는 뜻이므로 ①이 적절하다.
implication.distractor_ko: ② 정부 항의는 언급이 없다. ③ 안전한 장소라는 의미가 아니다. ④ 슬픔을 숨겼다는 내용이 아니다. ⑤ 구역을 갱단이 나눠 순찰했다는 뜻이 아니다.

passage: Picture a district that is fast becoming a slum once the economy collapses.
Shops shut down, and the buildings which their owners abandoned stand empty in the cold.
Only families who can't afford to move out stay behind through the winter.
Jobs grow scarce, gangs multiply, and fighting among the young becomes routine.
One day a gang called the Ghetto Brothers, which is respected because of its free meal programs, decides stopping the fighting.
Its members begin urging other young people to unite and rebuild their community.
Thanks to these new voices, gang leaders across the district put their names to a treaty.
Never again will they use violence to settle their quarrels.

underlines.text: who can't afford to move out

grammar.explanation_ko: decide 는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이므로 decides stopping 은 decides to stop 이 되어야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 진행형 주격 관계절로 적절하다. ② abandoned 의 목적어가 빠진 목적격 관계절이라 옳다. ③ 선행사가 사람이므로 who 가 맞다. ⑤ 부정어 Never 가 문두에 와서 조동사+주어로 도치된 정상 어순이다.

passage: Imagine an urban area that is fast becoming a slum after an economic recession.
Businesses close their doors and building owners have left the neighborhood behind.
The area is full of abandoned buildings, and there is no heating even in winter.
Only those who cannot afford to move out remain.
Unemployment is high, many gangs emerge, and violence between young people becomes an everyday thing.
One day a gang respected for its free meal and medical care programs decides to continue fighting.
Its members persuade young people to unite and create a better community.
Gang leaders from all over the area sign the treaty and renounce violence.
vocab.explanation_ko: 존경받던 갱단은 싸움을 '멈추기로' 결정했고 그래서 평화 협정으로 이어지므로 continue 는 문맥상 stop 이 되어야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 경기 침체로 슬럼화된다는 흐름에 맞다. ② 주인이 떠난 건물이므로 적절하다. ③ 실업률이 높다는 서술로 자연스럽다. ⑤ 협정에 서명하며 폭력을 '포기한다'는 의미로 옳다.

passage: After the recession, the district filled with empty buildings and cold apartments.
Unemployment was high and gang violence had become an everyday thing.
Then a gang respected for its free meals and medical care made an unexpected choice.
Rather than fight on, its members urged young people to unite and rebuild.
They suggested a peace treaty, insisting that the violence had taken away their brothers.
Gang leaders from all over the area signed it and vowed never to use violence again.
In other words, the community discovered that ______________________.
That discovery cleared the ground on which hip-hop culture would grow.
choices: peace had to be built by the very people who had been fighting
outside authorities were the only force able to restore order
economic recovery must come before any social change
music was more profitable than any form of street crime
moving out of the neighborhood was the wisest response
blank.explanation_ko: 싸우던 갱단 스스로가 협정을 제안하고 서명했으므로, 평화는 싸우던 당사자들이 직접 만들어야 했다는 ①이 빈칸에 적절하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ② 외부 권력은 등장하지 않는다. ③ 경제 회복이 선행되었다는 서술은 없다. ④ 수익성 비교는 본문에 없다. ⑤ 떠나는 것은 해결책으로 제시되지 않았다.

irrelevant.intro: In the early 1970s, an economic downturn left the South Bronx full of abandoned buildings and rising gang violence.
sentences: Only those who could not afford to move away remained in the freezing apartments.
Despair could be felt on every street corner of the district.
A gang called the Ghetto Brothers, respected for its free meal and medical care programs, decided to stop fighting.
Modern recording studios now rely on digital software to edit vocal tracks precisely.
Gang leaders from all over the area signed a peace treaty and renounced violence.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: ④는 현대 녹음 기술에 관한 진술로, 1970년대 브롱크스의 상황과 평화 협정이라는 흐름에서 벗어난다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②는 황폐해진 동네의 묘사, ③⑤는 평화 협정으로 이어지는 전개라 모두 흐름에 맞는다.

order.given: Imagine an urban area that is fast becoming a slum after an economic recession. Businesses close their doors, building owners leave, and the area fills with abandoned buildings that have no heating even in winter.

blocks.A: One day, however, a gang called the Ghetto Brothers, respected because of its free meal and medical care programs, decided to stop fighting. Its members began to persuade other young people to unite and create a better community instead.
blocks.B: Only those who could not afford to move out remained. Unemployment was high, many gangs emerged, and gang violence between young people became an everyday thing.
blocks.C: Thanks to these new voices, gang leaders from all over the area signed the treaty. Never again would they use violence to settle their disputes, and in that peace hip-hop was born.

order.explanation_ko: 황폐화(주어진 글) → 남은 사람들과 갱단 폭력(B) → 게토 브라더스의 결단(A) → 협정 서명과 힙합 탄생(C) 순이 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'One day, however' 는 폭력이 일상이 된 상황(B) 뒤에 와야 전환이 성립하고, (C)의 'these new voices' 는 (A)의 설득을 받는 표현이므로 마지막이어야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: They suggest a peace treaty, telling one another that the violence has already taken away too many of their brothers.

passage_marked.text: After the recession the district was full of abandoned buildings, and unemployment was high.
Gang violence between young people had become an everyday thing, and despair was on every street corner.
One day, however, a gang respected for its free meal and medical care programs decided to stop fighting.
Gang leaders from all over the area signed it and promised never to use violence again.
In that new peace, hip-hop was born as part of a culture created by African Americans and immigrants.

insert.explanation_ko: 협정을 제안하는 문장은 싸움을 멈추기로 한 결정(③ 앞) 뒤, 지도자들이 '그것에(it)' 서명하는 문장 앞에 와야 한다.
insert.distractor_ko: ④ 뒤에 넣으면 서명 대상인 treaty 가 뒤늦게 소개되어 it 의 지시 대상이 사라진다. ①②는 아직 평화 논의가 시작되기 전이다.

passage: An economic recession left the South Bronx full of empty buildings and unheated apartments.
Only the poorest families stayed, unemployment rose, and gang violence became routine.
Despair spread through every corner of the district.
Then a gang respected for its free meals and medical care chose to stop fighting.
It urged other young people to unite and build a better community.
Gang leaders across the area signed a peace treaty and renounced violence for good.
That agreement opened space for a new culture to take shape.
Hip-hop was born in that space, created by African Americans and immigrants.
summary.summary_template: Although economic __(A)__ had filled the Bronx with violence and despair, young people themselves chose to __(B)__ the fighting, and hip-hop grew out of the peace they made.
summary.explanation_ko: 경기 '붕괴'가 폭력과 절망을 낳았고, 젊은이들이 싸움을 '포기'한 데서 힙합이 자랐으므로 collapse–abandon 이 적절하다.
summary.distractor_ko: growth·reform 은 경기 침체와 반대이고, conceal(숨기다)·justify(정당화하다)는 폭력을 멈춘 행동과 맞지 않는다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들은 결코 다시는 분쟁을 해결하기 위해 폭력을 사용하지 않을 것이다.
writing.answer: Never again will they use violence to solve their disputes.
writing.explanation_ko: 부정어구 Never again 이 문두에 오면 조동사(will)+주어(they)+본동사 어순으로 도치된다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이사 갈 여력이 없는 사람들만 남는다.
writing.answer: Only those who can't afford to move out remain.
writing.explanation_ko: those who ~ 로 '~하는 사람들'을 나타내고, afford 는 to부정사를 목적어로 취한다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.context: The Ghetto Brothers were respected because of their free meal and medical care programs, so their call for peace carried real ___________ among other gangs.
writing.explanation_ko: 존경받았기 때문에 그들의 호소가 '무게(설득력)'를 지녔다는 의미로 weight 가 적절하다. (influence 도 가능)

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: This is the Bronx in the New York of the early 1970s, where hip-hop music was born as a major part of a new culture of peace created by African Americans and immigrants.
writing.answer: 이곳이 1970년대 초 뉴욕의 브롱크스인데, 이곳에서 힙합 음악은 아프리카계 미국인들과 이민자들이 창조한 새로운 평화 문화의 한 주축으로서 탄생하였다.
writing.explanation_ko: where 는 the Bronx 를 부연하는 계속적 용법의 관계부사이고, created 이하는 a new culture of peace 를 수식하는 과거분사구이다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Gang leaders across the Bronx signed a peace __(A)__ and promised to stop the __(B)__ that had become an everyday thing.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 지도자들이 서명한 것은 peace treaty 이고, 멈추기로 한 것은 everyday thing 이 된 violence 이다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
conditions: peace 와 hip-hop 을 반드시 포함할 것
writing.answer: Hip-hop was born in the Bronx after gangs chose peace instead of violence.
writing.explanation_ko: 폭력 대신 평화를 선택한 결과로 힙합이 탄생했다는 인과를 담으면 된다.
